subject: Onramp MAP + 30d Tech Validation Plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp MAP + 30d Tech Validation Plan

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I put together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on a 30-day acceptance sprint and a short tech-validation checklist so your engineers can exercise the happy path quickly. Attached are: MAP-template-30d-v1.docx and acceptance-matrix-v1.xlsx.

Quick ask: could you confirm the primary acceptance owner (name/email) and the target acceptance date you want us to anchor to? My proposed target would be 30 calendar days from kickoff, which would put acceptance around 2026-04-24 if we start next week.

High-level MAP (summary) — please review the attached doc:
- Week 0 (kickoff & access): sandbox access + test data ingestion (RACI included)
- Week 1–2 (tech validation): API latency/throughput baseline, model routing smoke tests, basic security checklist
- Week 3 (integration): UI flows, error handling, cost telemetry checks
- Week 4 (acceptance & handover): acceptance testing, sign-off, optional ramp to prod

I also created a shared Google Doc (edit link below) for collaborative edits so we can iterate the acceptance criteria in real time: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-example-MAP-edit (edit)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm stakeholders and preferred kickoff window
2) We schedule a 30-minute kickoff with your engineering and procurement teams
3) We add any additional acceptance gates you require into the acceptance matrix

Would you like me to loop in our Solutions Architect (Marissa) and an engagement lead (Ben) on the kickoff invite?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
[Attachment: MAP-template-30d-v1.docx]
[Attachment: acceptance-matrix-v1.xlsx]

Subject: Re: Onramp MAP + 30d Tech Validation Plan

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good and concise. A few notes from our side:

1) Acceptance owner: Emily Cho (me) for business sign-off, and Daniel Park (daniel.park@avatech.com) will be the engineering acceptance lead.
2) Target acceptance: April 24, 2026 works if we can kick off next Tuesday (Mar 30).
3) Sandbox: we will need a dedicated sandbox tenant and a short data-retention statement for security. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a 14-day sandbox retention and a SOC2 checklist?
4) Procurement: I looped in procurement — they will need a brief SOW and an initial cost estimate for the pilot. They prefer to receive SOW as a PDF.

I attached a short set of risk questions our security team asked (AvaTech-Pilot-Risk-Questions.pdf) — please have Marissa's team add any clarifying notes to the MAP doc.

Also happy to run a 30-minute kickoff on Mar 30 at 9am PT if that works for your team.

Best,
Emily
Head of Product, AvaTech
emily.cho@avatech.com
[Attachment: AvaTech-Pilot-Risk-Questions.pdf]
